difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that for a proper surjective morphism of algebraic spaces over an integral target there is an integral closed subspace whose restriction to the target is an alteration (statement lines 1413-1419). The proof (proof lines 1421-1446) picks a closed point of the fibre over the generic point, takes the reduced structure on its closure, verifies surjectivity, properness and the singleton fibre over the generic point, and concludes by the characterization of alterations together with the inheritance of decency. H2: a three-step construction with four inputs, written out in full.
